definition: Ultraviolet-visible spectroscopy measures how a sample absorbs or transmits ultraviolet and visible light as a function of wavelength.
entry_text: Ultraviolet-visible spectroscopy measures how a sample absorbs or transmits ultraviolet and visible light as a function of wavelength.
example: An analyst compares a sample's absorbance against calibration standards to estimate concentration.
label: Ultraviolet-visible spectroscopy
